address: 561 Ramkhamhaeng Road, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok, 10240, Thailand
bio: Chef Chudaree 'Tam' Debhakam brings the farm-to-table concept to life with her detailed, contemporary Thai tasting menu. Seasonal and sustainable ingredients, some sourced from her own backyard, highlight a culinary journey through Thailand. The dishes present bold flavours and delicate spices, crafted by a charming team within an elegant villa setting....
